units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:16:1">Koh. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>הלב הוֹגֶה</he> the heart reasons (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 49:4">Ps. XLIX, 4</cite> <he>הָגוּת</he>).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:2">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>הוֹגֶיהָ</he> those who study the Law, contrad. to <he>עוֹשֶׂיהָ</he>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:11:3">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ נח תורה וכ׳</he> Noah deducted a new law from a given law.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:1">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>שהוא הוגה בתורה וכ׳</he> who shall discuss the Law in seventy languages; a. fr.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="E00062"><he>הֶגֶה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:9">ib.</cite>) <he>זה נער שהוא הוגה</he> like a boy that spells (with difficulty).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 10a">Snh. X </cite>(IX), 1 <he>ההוגה וכ׳</he> he who pronounces the Divine Name as it is written, v. <cite ref="A00233"><he>אָגָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:12">Koh. R. to XII, 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="L00157"><he>להג</he></cite> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:12">ib.</cite>) <he>לֶהֱגוֹת ניתנו וכ׳</he> they are good for reading exercises but not for painful study; v. <cite ref="E00069"><he>הִגָּיוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1:9">Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לא יהא הוגה מפיו וקורא</he> he must not spell (the letters of a Biblical book) from memory and dictate for writing a scroll.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:4">Sabb. XII, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:5">5</cite>, <he>נֶהֱגִין זה עם זה</he> letters which can be read together (give sense).

senses.gloss: (also from יָגָה) to pierce, sting; ה׳ מכה to prickle, open a wound; trnsf. to lay bare a person’s disgrace.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 4</cite> (interpret. <he>נוגות</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">ib.</cite>) they assaulted her …, <he>עד שהִגּוּ את מכתה</he> and then laughed at her disgrace.
